_contract: Pure-data NG+ modifiers. CODE reads effects only; multipliers are floats, toggles are bools. Same-knob stacking multiplies. Gated to NG+ level >= 1 (see scripts/systems/new_game_plus.gd, MAX_NG_PLUS=3). en strings are i18n source; CONTENT never edits locales.

stacking.exclusive: symmetric exclusive_with lists; CODE must refuse co-selection

modifiers.notes: CODE: battery multiplies usable battery capacity/drain budget (0.80 = 20% less light per cell).

en.name: Long Night
en.desc: Battery yields 20% less light. The dark is patient; your cells are not.

modifiers.notes: CODE: hunter_hearing scales Hunter detection radius/gain; loot scales roll quantity chance.

en.name: Whisper
en.desc: Hunters hear 30% less, but loot yields 10% less. Tread soft, carry little.

modifiers.notes: CODE: extra_dark_districts is an ADDITIVE count carried as float (int(value) districts start DARK), not a multiplier. Exclusive with long_night: double-darkness stacking is unfair.

en.name: Blackout+
en.desc: One extra district starts DARK. No head start, no mercy.

modifiers.notes: CODE: hints=false disables hint prompts; lore scales lore-insight/XP-from-documents gains.

en.name: Keeper's Pact
en.desc: No hints. Lore insight doubled. He never explained either.

modifiers.notes: CODE: cycle scales night-cycle length; rewards scales coin/XP payouts; time_pressure enables the countdown HUD already used by timed events. Exclusive with whisper: stealth and sprint are opposite playstyles.

en.name: Sprint
en.desc: Night cycle 15% shorter, rewards +50%. Run the light home.

modifiers.notes: CODE: crawlers_ignore skips Crawler aggro; achievements=false blocks AchievementManager.unlock (still logged, never granted).

en.name: Ghost
en.desc: Crawlers ignore you. Achievements disabled. Unseen, unrecorded.
